sub_indicators.label: Gender gap in internet use
sub_indicators.subject: include.access
sub_indicators.text: Gender equity: gender gap in internet use
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Maputo Protocol asks for women's access to and control of information technologies on equal terms; the Digital Transformation Strategy asks for digital skills for women and girls.
criteria: The latest figure, for 2023 or later, puts the gender gap in internet use above 30 per cent.
The gender gap in internet use is 30 per cent or less, in the latest figure for 2023 or later, from ITU's series or a national household survey.
The gender gap in internet use is 20 per cent or less.
The gender gap in internet use is 10 per cent or less.
The gender gap in internet use is 2 per cent or less: parity.
